mapper.insert: insert into learning_points_log (user_id, change_amount, balance, type, ref_id, remark, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{changeAmount}, #{balance}, #{type}, #{refId}, #{remark}, sysdate())
mapper.select:
select l.log_id, l.user_id, l.change_amount, l.balance, l.type, l.ref_id, l.remark, l.create_time, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = l.user_id) as user_name from learning_points_log l
and exists (select 1 from sys_user u where u.user_id = l.user_id and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))
and l.type = #{type}
order by l.log_id desc
